notes: Fetched per period with periodId. Asked by lastModifiedDateTime the API returns only the balances modified in a period (pilot tenant: 15,066 rows in all, 981 for 202609); asked by periodId it returns every balance of the period (2,691 for 202609, 27,313+ keys over all periods, what v1 holds). DataMart carries the same 15,066 as the modified-since list, so it cannot fill the gap. The API also answers 400 when neither periodId nor lastModifiedDateTime is sent. period_scan walks first_period to the current month, one walk per month, on every run. It stops at the current month on purpose: asked for any future period the API returns a copy of the current balances (2,691 rows for each of the next 12 months), not stored data. periodToDateDebit and periodToDateCredit are not validation fields: the API leaves them out of a balance that had no movement in the period (45,574 of the 60,655 rows in a full scan).
